notes: Read SKILL.md in full. The skill covers Convex schema, queries, mutations, actions calling external APIs, cron jobs, auth config with Clerk, React client usage, deployment, and file storage.

Following it can make the agent install the convex package (npm install convex, npm create convex@latest), deploy to production (npx convex deploy), and set deployment environment secrets such as ANTHROPIC_API_KEY via npx convex env set (SKILL.md:259-275). These are the user's own deployment operations with the user's own keys, so medium risk is acceptable; production deploys and secret changes should be confirmed with the user.

The sample action (SKILL.md:147-176) sends user prompts to the Anthropic API from the user's backend; the API key shown is a placeholder (sk-ant-...). Related-skill links (../firebase-app-platform/, ../vercel-deployments/, ../../../devops/ai/agent-observability/ at SKILL.md:319-321) are optional pointers.
